claude_proposed_widenings.name: SenseKind.x_ray_vision
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: grant_sense exists in EffectAtom and the tracer handles it, but SenseKind is a closed union of darkvision | blindsight | tremorsense | truesight. X-ray vision is a distinct magical sense (see-through-solid-objects) that cannot be expressed with any current variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 feet for 1 minute. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.usagePenalty (or equivalent trigger on ActivationPhase)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The penalty save only triggers on the second+ use within a long rest. No existing surface type can express a conditional activation-phase that fires only when usage-count > 1 within the reset cadence. OngoingTrigger has no 'on_reuse' variant; ActivationPhase has no guard predicate based on prior use history. A new mechanism is needed — either a usagePenalty field on ActivatedAbilityMechanics or an on_reuse OngoingTrigger variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you use the ring again before taking a Long Rest, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
